description: §6.8.2 + §51.0.H Form 3 — a cell first written by an engine opener `effect=` (`@tasks = loadTasks()`, no other declaration) is reset to that write's value by `reset(@tasks)`. The effect loads [1, 2]; #grow pushes 3; #rst resets; @tasks is [1, 2] again. Pins s441 F2: lowering the effect body as a FUNCTION body dropped the effect write's reset registration, so `reset(@tasks)` became a silent no-op and @tasks stayed [1, 2, 3].
rationale: §6.8.1: "If `default=` is absent, `reset(@cell)` SHALL re-evaluate the init expression at reset time and write the result to the cell." The implicitly-declared @tasks has no `default=`, so reset re-evaluates its init (the effect's `loadTasks()`), undoing the push.
